name: codex-auto-router
description: Quality-aware Codex routing with a truthful live Router Studio

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.dev: npm run build && node --watch dist/cli.js start --auto --no-open
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
scripts.replay: npm run build && node dist/cli.js replay fixtures/spark-replay.jsonl
scripts.replay:validate: npm run build && node dist/cli.js replay fixtures/spark-replay.jsonl --headless
scripts.validate:runtime: npm run build && node dist/cli.js validate-runtime
